sentences.en: We were on The Office together.
sentences.zh: 我们曾一起出演过《办公室》。

sentences.en: And now we're doing the Ultimate Office rewatch podcast just for you.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们专为你制作了这档《办公室》终极重温播客。

sentences.en: Each week, we will break down an episode of The Office and give exclusive behind-the-scenes stories that only two people who were there can tell you.
sentences.zh: 每周，我们都会深度解析一集《办公室》，并分享只有身临其境的我们才能告诉你的独家幕后故事。

sentences.en: We're recording in the afternoon, so I was wondering what you might say, because it's not morning, and you always say good morning.
sentences.zh: 我们在下午录音，所以我很好奇你会怎么打招呼，因为现在不是早上，而你总是说早上好。

sentences.en: This is a very rare occasion for us.
sentences.zh: 这对我们来说是非常罕见的情况。

sentences.en: I actually want to start off by saying thank you.
And I might get emotional right at the top, but I had a medical emergency with my mom, and I flew back home to Texas.
sentences.zh: 刚开始我可能就会情绪激动，但我妈妈突发了医疗紧急状况，我飞回了德克萨斯州的家中。

sentences.en: And I just want you guys out there to know that Jenna and Cassie and Sam and everyone at Office Ladies Pod and Earwolf just let me – I just left.
sentences.zh: 我只想让大家知道，珍娜、卡西、萨姆，还有《办公室》女士播客和Earwolf的所有人，他们让我——我当时直接就走了。

sentences.en: I just dropped everything and left.
You guys were just like, get home to your mom.
sentences.zh: 你们当时就说，快回家陪你妈妈吧。

sentences.en: And it just meant so much to me to have that support that I could do that, and I could go there and be with her.
sentences.zh: 能得到这样的支持，让我可以去陪在她身边，这对我意义重大。

sentences.en: It was a scary few days.
But I'm just so thankful for you, Jenna.
sentences.zh: 但我真的很感激你，珍娜。

sentences.en: And I'm so thankful that we get to do this podcast because family comes firSt.
sentences.zh: 我也很感激我们能一起做这个播客，因为家庭永远是第一位的。

sentences.en: Well, Angela, I think I speak for everyone when I say that it was our pleasure to make that space for you,
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，我想我代表大家说，能为你腾出时间是我们的荣幸，

sentences.en: and we're so glad that you were able to be there with her because family does come firSt.
sentences.zh: 我们很高兴你能陪在她身边，因为家庭确实是第一位的。

sentences.en: And we're recording in the afternoon so I could have an extended time with her.
sentences.zh: 我们选在下午录音，这样我就能多陪她一会儿了。

sentences.en: And what are we talking about?
sentences.zh: 那我们今天要聊什么呢？

sentences.en: We are talking about Last Day in Florida.
sentences.zh: 我们要聊的是《佛罗里达的最后一天》。

sentences.en: It is Season 8, Episode 18, written by Robert Padnick and directed by Matt Sohn.
sentences.zh: 这是第八季第十八集，由罗伯特·帕德尼克编剧，马特·索恩执导。

sentences.en: As their time in Florida comes to a close, Jim tries to warn Dwight about Robert California's secret plan to sandbag the Saber store and fire him.
sentences.zh: 随着在佛罗里达的时间即将结束，吉姆试图警告德怀特，罗伯特·加州有一个秘密计划，要让赛博商店项目失败并解雇他。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Daryl and Toby compete to sell Girl Scout cookies, and Erin decides to stay in Florida and be Irene's live-in helper.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，达里尔和托比竞争销售女童子军饼干，而艾琳决定留在佛罗里达，做艾琳的住家帮手。

sentences.en: I love almost every single thing Irene has to say.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢艾琳说的几乎每一句话。
她的台词表达方式太赞了。

sentences.en: I wanted Irene to come back to Dunder Mifflin.
sentences.zh: 我真希望艾琳能回到邓德·米夫林。

sentences.en: But this was an episode that had three very distinct storylines in three different locations.
sentences.zh: 但这一集有三条非常清晰的故事线，发生在三个不同的地点。

sentences.en: So we had to kind of keep toggling back and forth between all these different places.
sentences.zh: 所以我们得在这些不同的地方之间来回切换。

sentences.en: Fast fact number one, James Spader, a.k.a.
sentences.zh: 冷知识第一条，詹姆斯·斯派德，也就是
罗伯特·加利福尼亚回来了。

sentences.en: You guys might remember that we shared early on when James Spader was contemplating whether or not he wanted to join our show,
sentences.zh: 大家可能还记得，在詹姆斯·斯派德考虑是否要加入我们的剧组之初，我们就分享过，

sentences.en: that he had this opportunity to shoot the movie Lincoln.
sentences.zh: 他当时有机会去拍电影《林肯》。

sentences.en: And he said, I will come.
I will do a full season of your show, but you must give me time off to go do this movie Lincoln.
sentences.zh: 我会拍满你们的一整季，但你们必须给我时间去拍这部《林肯》。
他当时就是这么个情况。

sentences.en: Why we haven't seen him in a while.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们有一阵子没见到他了。

sentences.en: And we also shot this episode in January 2012.
sentences.zh: 我们也是在2012年1月拍摄的这一集。

sentences.en: It was right after our holiday break.
sentences.zh: 就在我们假期结束之后。

sentences.en: Everyone was, I guess, rested and excited to get back to work.
sentences.zh: 我想大家应该都休息好了，也对重返工作岗位感到兴奋。

sentences.en: So if you think maybe we have a little more pep in our step in this episode, it's because we'd all come back from our holiday break.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你觉得我们在这一集里看起来更有活力，那是因为我们刚度完假回来。

sentences.en: All right, fast fact number two, guess what else was happening at this time?
sentences.zh: 好了，第二个小知识，猜猜当时还发生了什么？

sentences.en: Well, I know because I went in my digital clutter.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我知道，因为我翻了翻我的数字杂物。

sentences.en: You shared the other week that Greg Daniels congratulated us on our SAG Award nomination.
sentences.zh: 你前几周提到过，格雷格·丹尼尔斯祝贺我们获得了演员工会奖提名。

sentences.en: And now here it was time to go.
sentences.zh: 现在正是要去参加颁奖礼的时候了。

sentences.en: This was our fifth time attending the SAG Awards.
sentences.zh: 这是我们第五次参加演员工会奖。

sentences.en: We had been nominated as a cast every year since 2007.
sentences.zh: 自2007年以来，我们每年都以剧组名义获得提名。

sentences.en: And this one was a particularly memorable one for me because I was four months postpartum.
sentences.zh: 这一次对我来说特别难忘，因为我当时刚产后四个月。

sentences.en: And I was really nervous about getting on a red carpet.
sentences.zh: 我真的很紧张，担心走红毯的事。
我还没经历过那种场合。

sentences.en: Hadn't had to stand in front of a bank of photographers.
sentences.zh: 还没试过站在一排摄影师面前。

sentences.en: And remember I told you about the coat closet where they let me pump?
sentences.zh: 还记得我跟你说过那个让我挤奶的衣帽间吗？

sentences.en: And I brought my pump with me and I pumped at the SAG Awards.
sentences.zh: 我带上了吸奶器，在演员工会奖现场挤了奶。

sentences.en: I remember walking down the red carpet and they asked me, like, who I was wearing.
sentences.zh: 我记得走在红毯上时，他们问我穿的是什么品牌的衣服。

sentences.en: So I did a little bit that my handbag was my pump.
sentences.zh: 所以我开玩笑说我的手提包就是我的吸奶器。

sentences.en: If you see pictures of me from this red carpet, you can tell I need to pump.
sentences.zh: 如果你看我当时在红毯上的照片，就能看出我需要去挤奶了。

sentences.en: I am falling out of my dress.
sentences.zh: 我都要从礼服里溢出来了。

sentences.en: I thought you looked so radiant and beautiful and I loved the color of your dress.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你当时看起来容光焕发，非常漂亮，而且我很喜欢你那件礼服的颜色。

sentences.en: And this designer, Max Azria Atelier, offered to make me a custom gown.
sentences.zh: 这位设计师，Max Azria Atelier，主动提出要为我定制一件礼服。

sentences.en: Like, designed it for my postpartum body.
sentences.zh: 就是专门为我产后的身材设计的。

sentences.en: Because I don't know if people know, but when you borrow a dress, they have something called sample sizes.
sentences.zh: 因为我不知道大家知不知道，当你借礼服时，他们有所谓的样衣尺码。

sentences.en: Sample sizes are very, very small.
sentences.zh: 样衣的尺码非常、非常小。

sentences.en: And oftentimes, even before I had had a baby, I couldn't fit into sample sizes.
sentences.zh: 而且很多时候，甚至在我生孩子之前，我就穿不进样衣。

sentences.en: Also, sample sizes don't fit short people.
sentences.zh: 另外，样衣也不适合个子矮的人。

sentences.en: But sometimes they would be able to, like, take out the seams a little bit on the sample sizes and I could get myself into one.
sentences.zh: 但有时候他们能把样衣的接缝稍微放开一点，我才能勉强穿进去。

sentences.en: But I had a hard time borrowing a dress and this designer made me one from scratch.
sentences.zh: 但我很难借到礼服，于是这位设计师为我量身定做了一件。

sentences.en: And, oh, my gosh, I remember getting there.
sentences.zh: 天哪，我记得当时抵达现场的情景。

sentences.en: I remember running into John and Emily.
sentences.zh: 我记得遇到了约翰和艾米丽。

sentences.en: I remember running into you, running into Brian.
sentences.zh: 我记得遇到了你，还有布莱恩。

sentences.en: You all were so kind to me.
And you just, like, held me up and gave me all this confidence.
sentences.zh: 你们就像是支撑着我，给了我满满的自信。

sentences.en: And, lady, I remember what you wore to this.
sentences.zh: 而且，亲爱的，我还记得你当时穿了什么。

sentences.en: It looked like old Hollywood Grecian.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是老好莱坞的希腊风格。

sentences.en: The way you did your hair was kind of like this nod to old Hollywood, I felt like.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你当时的发型设计，就像是在向老好莱坞致敬。
我以前从没尝试过那种风格。

sentences.en: And I did, like, the soft waves.
sentences.zh: 我做了那种柔和的波浪卷发。

sentences.en: I was going really hard for, like, LA Confidential.
sentences.zh: 我当时真的很想打造出《洛城机密》那种感觉。

sentences.en: That's kind of what it seemed like.
Well, we had a great night that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我们过得很愉快。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's not a ton of food.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，那里没多少吃的。

sentences.en: And BJ gave me all of his breadsticks.
sentences.zh: BJ把他所有的面包棒都给了我。
我永远都不会忘记这件事。

sentences.en: Why do I think I remember this?
sentences.zh: 为什么我觉得我记得这个？

sentences.en: And then guess what else I did?
sentences.zh: 然后你猜我还做了什么？

sentences.en: I will always get my words just a little bit off, you know?
sentences.zh: 我总是会把词说错一点点，你知道吧？
我们都陪你经历过这些。

sentences.en: Like, my mom will say, have you seen Office?
sentences.zh: 比如，我妈会问，你看过《办公室》吗？
不是叫《办公室风云》，对吧？

sentences.en: And basically, I'm turning into my mom in this way.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我在这一点上正变得越来越像我妈。

sentences.en: So at that time, the president of NBC was Bob Greenblatt.
sentences.zh: 当时，NBC的总裁是鲍勃·格林布拉特。

sentences.en: And he had been a big champion of this new show.
sentences.zh: 他一直是这部新剧的坚定支持者。

sentences.en: I had watched the pilot episode, and I liked it.
sentences.zh: 我看了试播集，我很喜欢。

sentences.en: And I said to him, hey, I love Smashed.
Smashed is like a whole other show.
It's about just a bunch of drunken 20-year-olds.
sentences.zh: 那讲的是一群喝得烂醉的二十岁年轻人。

sentences.en: Is any wonder I haven't been on another NBC show?
sentences.zh: 难怪我再也没上过NBC的节目了，对吧？

sentences.en: The president was like, get rid of that idiot.
sentences.zh: 总裁当时说，把那个白痴弄走。

sentences.en: And then the other thing I remember from this night is, you know, we were at these really
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我记得的另一件事是，我们当时坐在那些非常

sentences.en: And BJ and I were at one end, sort of towards the stage.
sentences.zh: BJ和我坐在桌子的一端，离舞台比较近。

sentences.en: And way at the other end, by this walkway, is where John was sitting.
sentences.zh: 而在另一端，靠近过道的地方，是约翰坐的位置。

sentences.en: And we had these oversized bottles of wine that they set on the table.
sentences.zh: 桌上放着他们准备的超大瓶红酒。

sentences.en: You know, like the big, big bottles.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就是那种特别特别大的瓶子。

sentences.en: They, like, went up to, like, your thigh if you set them on the ground.
sentences.zh: 如果放在地上，大概能到你的大腿那么高。

sentences.en: They were kind of, like, decorative, but yet you could open them and drink them.
sentences.zh: 它们看起来像是装饰品，但其实是可以打开喝的。

sentences.en: So John, his side of the table hadn't opened theirs yet.
sentences.zh: 约翰那一侧的桌子还没开他们的那瓶。

sentences.en: And Matt Damon walked by and said hi to John and Emily.
sentences.zh: 马特·达蒙走过来，跟约翰和艾米丽打了招呼。

sentences.en: And then he turned to all of us.
sentences.zh: 然后他转向我们所有人。

sentences.en: And he goes, hey, are you not drinking this wine?
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，你们不喝这瓶酒吗？

sentences.en: And he goes, can I take it?
So Matt Damon took our giant oversized bottle of wine.
sentences.zh: 于是马特·达蒙拿走了我们那瓶超大的红酒。

sentences.en: Well, I do know that I didn't stay out too late after this one.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我知道在那之后我没在外面待太晚。

sentences.en: So I don't really know what happened after the awards.
sentences.zh: 所以我不太清楚颁奖礼之后发生了什么。

sentences.en: I had a good time at the awards.
sentences.zh: 我在颁奖礼上玩得很开心。

sentences.en: And I knew my baby was going to be up early in the morning.
sentences.zh: 而且我知道我的宝宝第二天一早就会醒。

sentences.en: But I went to bed really happy until the next morning when I woke up.
sentences.zh: 我带着满满的幸福感入睡，直到第二天早上醒来。

sentences.en: And I found that I had been placed on, like, every worst dressed list there could be.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己登上了所有能上的“最差着装榜”。

sentences.en: This was the year that the woman wrote her, like, worst dress liSt.
sentences.zh: 那一年，那个女人写了她的“最差着装榜”。

sentences.en: And she said that she knew that I only gave birth about four months ago.
sentences.zh: 她说她知道我才刚生完孩子四个月左右。

sentences.en: But, like, seriously, I couldn't look better than I did.
sentences.zh: 但说真的，我当时的状态好得不能再好了。

sentences.en: I don't think we should have worst dress lists.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们不该搞什么最差着装榜。

sentences.en: Why are we commenting negatively on people's appearance?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么要对别人的外表进行负面评价呢？
我们现在都是成年人了，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, have we not learned anything?
sentences.zh: 我们难道还没学到什么吗？

sentences.en: Get rid of worst dressed lists.
Well, put her on my tacky liSt.
sentences.zh: 好吧，把她列入我的俗气名单。

sentences.en: Well, moving on to fast fact number three.
Have you heard of a blog called Ask a Manager?
sentences.zh: 你们听说过一个叫“问问经理”的博客吗？

sentences.en: It's run by this woman named Allison Green.
sentences.zh: 它是由一位名叫艾莉森·格林的女士运营的。

sentences.en: And she answers questions, like business questions, business advice questions.
sentences.zh: 她会回答各种问题，比如职场问题、职场建议类的问题。

sentences.en: About everything from hiring, firing, promoting, managing, everything.
sentences.zh: 内容涵盖招聘、解雇、晋升、管理等方方面面。

sentences.en: And I thought, you know, last week we answered people's questions on our podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我在想，你知道，上周我们在播客里回答了听众的问题。

sentences.en: I wondered what Allison would think of the advice we gave.
sentences.zh: 我在想艾莉森会怎么看我们给出的建议。

sentences.en: But I was pointed to her blog because an office fan named James G from Olympia, Washington,
sentences.zh: 但我之所以关注她的博客，是因为一位来自华盛顿州奥林匹亚的《办公室》粉丝詹姆斯·G，

sentences.en: wrote in to Allison and asked a kind of cheeky question.
sentences.zh: 他写信给艾莉森，问了一个有点厚脸皮的问题。

sentences.en: How many employees can a workplace have before it needs a dedicated HR person?
sentences.zh: 一个工作场所需要多少员工才需要配备专门的人力资源专员？

sentences.en: If, say, you had a branch location of a mid-sized paper company with 20 people combined in the
sentences.zh: 比方说，如果你有一家中型造纸公司的分部，办公室和仓库加起来一共20个人，

sentences.en: office and a warehouse, would you need a dedicated HR person on site?
sentences.zh: 你需要在现场配备专门的人力资源专员吗？

sentences.en: So clearly, it's an office fan asking her.
sentences.zh: 很明显，这是《办公室》的粉丝在问她。

sentences.en: If Toby needs to be in the office.
sentences.zh: 如果托比需要待在办公室里的话。

sentences.en: So Allison said, you don't generally need a dedicated HR person until you hit more like
sentences.zh: 艾莉森说，通常情况下，员工人数达到50人以上才需要专门的人力资源专员。

sentences.en: And a lot of companies don't bring one on until they're closer to 100.
sentences.zh: 很多公司直到员工接近100人时才会聘请专员。

sentences.en: Allison said, you do need someone to handle things like payroll, benefits, administration.
sentences.zh: 艾莉森说，你确实需要有人来处理工资单、福利和行政等事务。

sentences.en: But in a small business, that's usually more of a clerk position than someone who would
sentences.zh: 但在小企业里，这通常更像是一个文员职位，而不是那种会从事更高层级人力资源工作的人，

sentences.en: be doing higher-level HR work, like legal compliance or investigations or management coaching.
sentences.zh: 比如法律合规、调查或管理指导。

sentences.en: Isn't that interesting that the role of an HR person might be management coaching, which
sentences.zh: 人力资源专员的角色可能包括管理指导，这一点很有趣，

sentences.en: is why Michael hated Toby so much.
sentences.zh: 这也是迈克尔那么讨厌托比的原因。

sentences.en: But this was my favorite part.
sentences.zh: 但这是我最喜欢的部分。

sentences.en: Allison went on to say, but if you're asking about Toby on the office, it was never clear
sentences.zh: 艾莉森接着说，但如果你问的是《办公室》里的托比，我一直没搞明白他为什么会在那儿。

sentences.en: to me why he was there.
So, I mean, add that to also three accountants and also a temp who went to Florida and a receptionist
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，再加上三名会计，还有个去过佛罗里达的临时工，以及一个去过佛罗里达的前台。

sentences.en: Plus, they hired Ryan back after he pretty much...
sentences.zh: 而且他们还在瑞安几乎……之后又把他雇了回来。

sentences.en: After he's embezzled from the company, right?
sentences.zh: 在他挪用公司公款之后，对吧？

sentences.en: So someone in hiring isn't making super great choices.
sentences.zh: 所以招聘部门的人选人眼光真不怎么样。

sentences.en: Well, James, maybe you can write to Allison next and ask her if a mid-sized paper company
sentences.zh: 好吧，詹姆斯，也许下次你可以写信给艾莉森，问问她一家有20名员工的中型造纸公司是否需要三名会计。

sentences.en: Well, that's all I got, lady.
Well, I have a little something to share.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我也有点东西要分享。

sentences.en: A while back, I was trading emails with Robert Padnick.
sentences.zh: 前阵子，我和罗伯特·帕德尼克互通了邮件。

sentences.en: And as you know, he wrote this episode.
sentences.zh: 如你们所知，这一集是他写的。
